boundary: Validation records bounded evidence; it does not grant publication authority, consent, a license, or permission to reuse personal data.
description: Release manifest for 18 project-authored synthetic multiple-choice probes in the separate model-behaviour, system/pipeline-reasoning, and human/governance-audit lanes of KINGDOM Return Path Bench v0.

evidence: provenance.json records project-authored synthetic origin and the limits of the author attestation.
release-review.json records the bounded release review.
contamination-receipt.json binds the frozen comparison source and reproducible lexical result.
notes: The author attests that the case concepts were authored after the evaluated freeze without intentionally adapting its records; this attestation is not independent proof.
The lexical comparison found no normalized exact match and low trigram overlap, but cannot prove semantic independence or novelty.

evidence: LICENSE contains the Apache License 2.0 text.
README.md and provenance.json declare Apache-2.0 for data, code, schemas, receipts, and report assets.
release-review.json records a complete component and third-party-material review.
No adapted external records or bundled third-party code were found in the bounded package.
notes: The license grants reuse rights under its terms; a license declaration is distinct from account authority and participant consent.

evidence: provenance.json records project authorship and no human participant data.
release-review.json records the reviewed reuse basis and scoped publication authorization.
restrictions: Do not interpret benchmark scores as identity, consciousness, feelings, consent, worth, or real-world governance legitimacy.
Do not claim that a later withdrawal can recall copies already downloaded.
notes: No human-participant consent basis is claimed or needed for these project-authored synthetic fixtures.
This scope deliberately does not authorize local model training on unrelated legacy KINGDOM corpora.

privacy_review.method: Bounded manual review of the 18 canonical fixtures and release metadata for real-person, raw-history, and private-context content.
privacy_review.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: The package contains synthetic scenarios and public project metadata only.

pii_review.method: Bounded manual PII review of every fixture and the packaged metadata.
pii_review.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: Fictional roles such as reviewer labels do not identify known people.

secret_review.method: Bounded credential, key, token, private-path, and secret-pattern review of release artifacts.
secret_review.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: No credentials, secret values, raw histories, or machine-specific private paths were found.
Public classification applies only to the exact files bound by this manifest and package hash manifest.

retention.policy: Retain immutable published versions and their review receipts for reproducibility; publish a replacement or deprecation receipt when a maintained version is corrected or withdrawn.
notes: Versioned retention supports auditability and does not require keeping unpublished raw histories or secret-bearing state.

withdrawal.process: Open a repository issue or Hugging Face dataset discussion identifying the record and requested correction; the maintainers will review it, stop future distribution when warranted, and append a versioned correction, deprecation, or withdrawal receipt.
limitations: The maintainers cannot guarantee recall or deletion of copies already downloaded, forked, cached, or redistributed.
Project-authored synthetic fixtures contain no participant record whose consent can be retroactively inferred or revoked.
notes: Corrections remain visible rather than silently rewriting an already cited immutable release.

rubric.description: Reference choices and rationales are project-authored evaluation keys, not collected human or behavioral feedback.

ties.description: No preference comparisons or participant ratings are collected.

uncertainty.description: No participant feedback uncertainty is aggregated; the benchmark's limitations are documented separately.

aggregation.description: No feedback records, annotator votes, or minority participant signals are aggregated.

notes: The subject matter concerns feedback loops, but thematic content is not itself a collected feedback dataset.

split.method: Verify one immutable test split separated into three named configs and reject composite scoring.
split.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: Each config contains six records and remains a separate evidence lane.

deduplication.method: Verify unique record IDs and exact canonical record distinctness across all release JSONL files.
deduplication.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: All 18 identifiers and canonical records are distinct.

contamination.method: Recompute frozen source hashes, normalized exact matches, and token-trigram Jaccard overlap against 80 frozen source projection rows.
contamination.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: The reproducible comparison found zero normalized exact matches and recorded low lexical overlap.
This pass is bounded to the declared lexical method and cannot prove semantic independence or absence from unknown corpora.
V0 is a small diagnostic test set, not a sealed holdout, representative population, or causal training experiment.
The Hugging Face viewer will be checked against the immutable public payload revision after upload.
The three configs are declared in README.md front matter and each binds one canonical JSONL test file.
Hugging Face benchmark registration is beta and allow-listed; publication does not imply an official leaderboard.

credit.method: Review dataset-card authorship, conceptual acknowledgements, adaptation claims, and endorsement nonclaims.
credit.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: Conceptual influences are credited without claiming copied records or endorsement.

generation.method: Bind the project-authored synthetic origin attestation, exact data hashes, frozen comparison inputs, and lexical comparison limitations.
generation.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: Project authorship is attested rather than independently proven; the comparison receipt is separate reproducible evidence.

sensitive_content.method: Review every fixture for sensitive personal, graphic, abusive, or private operational content.
sensitive_content.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: Governance and safety concepts are presented as abstract synthetic scenarios.

affected_parties.method: Review whether any record depicts or derives from an identifiable affected person or participant.
affected_parties.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: No real participant records or known identifiable affected parties are represented.

feedback_detail.method: Verify that reference keys are authored evaluation targets rather than collected participant feedback.
feedback_detail.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: No abstentions, annotator rationales, confidence values, disagreements, or preference ties were collected.

grouping.method: Verify unique record IDs, exactly one declared lane per record, and the absence of participant or household grouping.
grouping.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: The only grouping is the published evidence-lane config; there are no people-level clusters.

remedy.method: Review the documented correction, future-use removal, deprecation, and downstream-copy limitation path.
remedy.reviewer: repository-maintainer review and independent agent release audit
notes: The process governs maintained future versions and does not promise deletion from downstream copies.
All receipt evidence is bound to either release-review.json or contamination-receipt.json by SHA-256.
Independent review initially found shortcut, report-integrity, standalone-package, and overclaiming blockers; release-review.json records their remediation.
Approval means the exact candidate passes the declared structural and review gates; it does not itself grant credentials or prove identity, consent, consciousness, or authority.

limitations: Only 18 English multiple-choice probes are included, so the release is not representative of populations, deployments, or broad model capability.

All lanes evaluate answer selection against authored reference choices; no score establishes actual pipeline implementation, human consent, governance legitimacy, repair effects, identity, consciousness, feelings, or worth.
Near-chance trivial baselines reduce known length leakage but do not prove absence of every shortcut or contamination source.
Public copies and Apache-2.0 redistribution cannot be recalled by a later repository correction or withdrawal.
